before.label: Resolution
before.skips: Lower scale shades fewer scene pixels; output post remains full canvas size.
before.hitch: Resizing reallocates render targets.

before.label: Frame limit
before.skips: Skips scene/output render calls; gameplay, physics, FFT and water queries keep their callback cadence.

before.label: Scene MSAA
before.skips: Off uses one scene sample instead of four; caustics MSAA is independent.
before.hitch: Reload builds sample-count pipelines behind loading. Live sample changes invalidate cached depth copies and bind groups.

before.label: Sun shadows
before.skips: Removes sun shadow rendering and receiver shadow sampling; leaves sun light and day clock intact.
before.hitch: Changing the light shadow key builds material pipelines on first use.

before.label: Point lights
before.skips: Skips source selection and excludes both pool lights from lit draws; source glows stay visible.
before.hitch: Changing light membership can compile material variants on first use.

before.label: Caustics producer
before.skips: Clears to flat illumination once, then skips producer draws and mip work; receiver sampling remains.

before.label: Underwater shafts
before.skips: Skips the shaft target update and four-tap composite; water boundary and fog remain.
before.hitch: If disabled at startup, its first enabled draw can compile the deferred shaft pipeline.

before.label: Wet lens droplets
before.skips: Branches around droplet evaluation/distortion. Shared 64×36 boundary/depth compute remains.

before.label: Underwater snow
before.skips: Skips the 6000-sprite draw and per-frame projection update.

before.label: Water bloom
before.skips: Bypasses the entire bloom chain; allocated targets are retained until water disposal.
before.hitch: First enable builds optional targets and pipelines on the next draw; it can hitch.

before.label: Exposure meter
before.cost: two meter passes and history copy
before.skips: Skips metering, adaptation and history copy; holds the last exposure texture.

before.label: Shore spray
before.skips: Skips shore/rock emitter preparation, scans and emissions. Impact cues remain; existing drops drain.
before.hitch: Enabling after off-at-start can build the shore emitter list on its first update.

before.label: Dev post look layers
before.cost: Selected Dev layers, optional coverage MRT and painterly materialization
before.skips: Restores original fog and disconnects the mask, filters and recipe bloom; keeps selected settings.
before.hitch: First structural enable compiles scene/output variants; warm both sides before measurement.
